controls_observer.contract: The update receives its controls object in RCX. Observe only after normal return. Connection, generation (including UINT64_MAX), derived-bit-1 predicate identity and source short-circuit order retain the previous layout. No engine predicate is invoked by the observer; raw enablement and source availability do not establish exclusive gameplay ownership.
controls_observer.evidence: Compared 2036 instructions across the controls getter, update, reducer and view publication region with retained October disassembly. Fields and local branches are unchanged after relocation. The analog/digital reader guard paths retain generation, predicate and source checks; a separate relocated inline switch table is not an object-layout change.

menu_observer.abi: void(query temporary address in RCX, UIStateStacks address in RDX, uint8_t* matched_active_context in R8, uint8_t* last_match_flag_5c in R9). All arguments are borrowed and forwarded unchanged.
menu_observer.outputs: The reviewed worker zeroes distinct stack bytes at rsp+0x20 and rsp+0x21 before the call. The helper sets the first to one on a qualifying active context and overwrites the second with that context byte +0x5c. Copy only after normal helper return, before returning to the worker. The last-match byte is not a Boolean or a named menu subtype.
menu_observer.raw_bit_correlation: The worker latches controls raw bit5 before the helper. Separate controls and menu samples do not recreate that latched value or an atomic frame snapshot.
menu_observer.evidence: All 633 instructions in registration/worker/helper/dispatcher and 1071 instructions in the applied stack read/activity region match the previous executable after image-reference relocation. Call ABI, caller return RVA and output lifetimes are unchanged.

observation.activation: An empty crml/input-context.enabled marker enables both diagnostic observers in CRML_MOVEMENT_PROBE builds on the reviewed October update and October hotfix profiles. Original and unknown executable profiles remain refused.
observation.lifetime: Only completed copied values are exposed; observations expire after 100 ms. The menu observer rejects unreviewed callers, nonzero initial outputs, overlap and unwind. No engine pointer is retained in either published snapshot.
observation.logging: At most 64 semantic changes per observer, sampled no faster than every 250 ms. Status and observed fields trigger a record; callback-thread migration alone does not spend the budget. Thread ID is included when a record is emitted.
observation.runtime_delivery: Traces for this executable include connected generation-matching action views with predicate/source enabled and disabled, and completed navigation scans with matched values zero and one. Unavailable and stale observations also occur. These records establish callback delivery, not a mapping to specific menus or exclusive gameplay ownership.
observation.limits: No input suppression, guest API or gameplay permission is granted. Missing or negative menu context cannot prove gameplay. Text entry, named menu coverage and loading/reload semantics remain unverified. The PageContent text-input callback is not ported or enabled by this adapter map.
